community.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
community.heading: PLAYER REQUIREMENTS
community.content:
3. PLAYER REQUIREMENTS
3.1. All League players must have a signed/accepted waiver with LWR PC and have a valid
LWR PC membership. To sign up, go to https://lwrpickleballclub.com/signup/.
3.2. All DUPR League players must have a free DUPR ID which can be found at:
https://www.dupr.com/.
3.3. All DUPR League players must join our free DUPR club, which is diƯerent/separate from
the LWR PC membership: https://tinyurl.com/LWRPC-DUPRCLUB
3.4. Players are assigned to a community based on their primary address at the start of the
season.
3.5. Players may form teams with members from other communities; however, they are not
permitted to play for another community’s team if their own community already has a
team in their division.
3.6. Captains are expected to prioritize players from the local community ahead of those from
outside the community. As a community-based league, we emphasize the inclusion of
local players over non-local players.
3.7. Players are permitted to join or substitute for multiple community teams within the same
community, provided that all League and DUPR rating regulations are adhered to.
3.8. Players must be at least 19 years old.
3.9. Players are responsible for verifying their paddle is on the current Approved Paddle List
(https://equipment.usapickleball.org/paddle-list/).

community.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide
community.heading: CREATE/UPDATE TEAM ROSTER
community.content:
CREATE/UPDATE TEAM ROSTER
o Enter or update your player team roster prior to the commencement of each season. Use the
Manage Roster option to add or remove players.
 All players must be active Lakewood Ranch Pickleball Club members before playing. To
join, they can visit: https://lwrpickleballclub.com/signup.
 All DUPR League players must have a free DUPR ID which can be created at
https://www.dupr.com.
 All players must join the Lakewood Ranch Pickleball Club DUPR club (free and
separate from the LWR PC membership) so we can accurately sync player ratings.
Captains should share this link with all players: https://tinyurl.com/LWRPC-DUPRCLUB.
o Roster Requirements & Substitutes: Teams must roster enough players and substitutes (who
are not already on another team) to field a full lineup weekly. For example, if your match
requires 6 players, an 8–10 player roster is recommended. Additional substitutes may be drawn
from other teams in the same community, provided they meet the DUPR division rating
requirements. For complete details, see the Player Requirements and DUPR Rating/Divisions
sections in the DUPR League Mission and Rules.
o Captain Roster Control: Captains are responsible for building their own rosters and may add
or delete players throughout the season as needed provided the player is a current, valid
member of the LWR PC, has a DUPR ID and is eligible for that division.
o Player DUPR Ratings: Season DUPR ratings are updated in the LMS before the season starts
and remain visible to captains all season. For players added midseason, their rating is based on
the date the league's season ratings were originally recorded.

community.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide
community.sectionLabel: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
community.heading: HOW TO REGISTER YOUR TEAM (SIGNING UP YOUR TEAM)
community.content:
• Complete all required questions to set up your team. Most of the information you enter, such as
your Team Name, Captain, and other team details, can be changed later. This initial information
will be used to create and activate your team and associate it with the appropriate community and
related league information.
• Once you have completed the registration form, click Register My Team! You will then be prompted
to enter your payment information or, if available, select your current payment method already on
file.
• After completing your registration, you will receive a confirmation email with your team registration
details, important next steps, and upcoming dates and deadlines.
• League Management will then activate your team and assign you and/or the individuals designated
during registration as the Captain and Co-Captain(s). Once this is completed, your initial team
registration and setup will be complete.
• League Management will notify you when team rosters for your league have been unlocked and are
available for you to begin adding and managing your players.

community.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club Code of Conduct
community.content:
2. Respect for Host Communities
As a decentralized league, LWR PC relies on the goodwill of local communities.
• Facility Stewardship: Club Members must respect the specific rules of the
community providing the courts (e.g., parking regulations, noise ordinances, and
guest policies).
• Neutrality: Club Members are guests in these communities. Any behavior that
jeopardizes LWR PC’s relationship with a host community is considered a Level 2
violation.

Player Eligibility & DUPR Ratings
Click the Add Player button to add a player to your roster.
• Selection: A pop-up window will appear with your home community preselected.
Use the drop-down menu to view available players, along with their eligibility status
and DUPR ratings.
• Missing DUPR Info: If a player is missing a DUPR ID or Season Rating, select the
player and click Add Player to Team. League Management will automatically be
notified to review the issue and update you on their status.
• Ineligible Players: If a player is marked "Not Eligible," attempting to add them will
display an on-screen message explaining the specific reason why.

timing.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
timing.heading: Team DUPR Rating Requirements
timing.content:
4.6. Team DUPR Rating Requirements: A team's DUPR Rating is calculated by adding the
Season DUPR Ratings of both players. Each division has established minimum and
maximum individual player ratings, as well as a maximum combined Team DUPR
Rating. These limits are strictly enforced.
4.6.1. Every lineup fielded for a match must comply with both the individual player rating
requirements and the maximum combined Team DUPR Rating for that division.
Teams that fail to meet these requirements will automatically forfeit the aƯected
games.
4.6.2. Games forfeited due to an invalid lineup will not be submitted to DUPR. The
League Management System will automatically record the forfeits and update team
records and league standings accordingly.

timing.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
timing.heading: DUPR RATINGS/DIVISIONS
timing.content:
4. DUPR RATINGS/DIVISIONS
4.1. Season DUPR Ratings: A player's Season DUPR Rating is established on the date
communicated to all captains prior to the first scheduled league match and remains in
eƯect for the duration of the season.
4.1.1. A player with a DUPR Reliability Factor below 29 will be classified as “Not Rated”
(NR) for League purposes and will be subject to the provisions of Rule 4.5. This
classification recognizes that a player’s current DUPR rating may not yet provide a
suƯiciently reliable indication of skill level, particularly for newer or less-established
players or those who have not recently recorded matches in DUPR. Players
classified as “NR” may be placed on a team in the division that most appropriately
reflects their current skill level while they record additional matches and establish a
more reliable DUPR rating. These players are strongly encouraged to consult with a
local Certified DUPR Coach, pickleball professional, or knowledgeable team
captain for guidance regarding appropriate division placement.
4.2. All DUPR ratings will be truncated to the nearest tenth to establish a player's “Season's
DUPR Rating”. For example, a rating of 3.496 will be truncated to 3.4, as will a rating of
3.401.
4.3. Some of our Leagues use the “Age-based” DUPR sub-rating but will still follow all DUPR
Rating/Division Rules. If a player hasn’t established their 65+ Age-based rating as of the
start of a season, their 50+ Age-based rating will be used.
4.4. Any player or team that is found to be cheating, tanking, game-fixing or any kind of data
manipulation, including intentionally creating multiple DUPR accounts, will be banned
from the League for one calendar year.
